What happens when two candidates get exactly the same number of votes? In Rajasthan, two district chief elections were decided by a lottery after candidates secured 14 votes each.
But this isn't the first time a simple ballot has decided an election. From India's Rajya Sabha and municipal elections to a closely contested Virginia Assembly seat in the US, we look at some fascinating cases where luck decided the winner.
